calls.title: Sync with Vibrant Talent: Demand and Developer Advocate roles and Ashley Stirrup
calls.summary: The meeting addressed the hiring strategy for demand generation and developer advocate roles, highlighting the importance of balancing strategic presence and hands-on execution. For demand generation, Ashley emphasized the need for at least a director-level candidate, with Lindsey presenting as the preferred choice pending her presentation performance. Coaching on communication and strategic skills has been arranged for Lindsey. In the developer advocate search, technical credibility and prior coding experience were identified as key criteria, with Jeff currently seen as the leading candidate due to his strengths over others like Jessica and Corey. Additionally, the team underscored the necessity for candidates who understand front-end development, avoiding those from backend-focused backgrounds, while also refining the interview process and improving communication about candidate status.
calls.keywords: Demand Generation, Developer Advocate, Executive Presence, Technical Interviews, Candidate Evaluation, Marketing Leadership
